headlines: An app opened on the phone every 11 minutes between 09:00 and 18:00: 49 phone sessions a day in that window, median gap 3.5 minutes. 37% of phone sessions start with Instagram. 31% last under 30 seconds.
On the Mac, WhatsApp comes to the front 37 times a day. That is once every 7.5 minutes of Mac use, with a median gap of 1.2 minutes. 49% of those visits last under 30 seconds.
6.7 disruptions a day during focus, 11 minutes a day in the apps that caused them. Longest uninterrupted stretch: 22 minutes on a typical day with focus, 25 minutes at best.
A disruption of 36 seconds costs 1.1 minutes before the app that was left is back in front (medians over 40 disruptions). That adds up to 13 minutes a day.
WhatsApp broke focus 19 times on 5 of 5 days with focus, 15 minutes in total. Next: Instagram, 13 times on 4 days.
2 minutes of off task browsing during focus on 5 days with focus: social 2 minutes.
Screens on after 23:00 on 4 of 6 nights, a median of 61 minutes. Most used then: Instagram.
39 app switches per active hour. 29% of screen time is spent in stays shorter than 2 minutes (median stay 21 seconds).
Screen time 8h 38 a day over 7 days (Mac 3h 21, iPhone 5h 17). Most of it: social 2h 55, other 2h 29, communication 100 minutes a day.
AI tools open for 2h 25 a day by the clock, 9 sessions a day (63 sessions, 20h 43 of session time in total). 36% of session time was the tool waiting for the user.

phone_cadence.minimum: at least 3 days of iPhone usage and 20 waking gaps between sessions; an hour needs 5 gaps, the working window 20
phone_cadence.summary: An app opened on the phone every 11 minutes between 09:00 and 18:00: 49 phone sessions a day in that window, median gap 3.5 minutes. 37% of phone sessions start with Instagram. 31% last under 30 seconds.

mac_app_cadence.minimum: at least 3 days of Mac usage; an app needs 10 activations on 2 or more days, and 5 gaps for a median gap
mac_app_cadence.summary: On the Mac, WhatsApp comes to the front 37 times a day. That is once every 7.5 minutes of Mac use, with a median gap of 1.2 minutes. 49% of those visits last under 30 seconds.

focus_disruptions.minimum: at least one focus stretch (15 minutes or more, at least half of it in work apps) or one planned goal block with device data
focus_disruptions.summary: 6.7 disruptions a day during focus, 11 minutes a day in the apps that caused them. Longest uninterrupted stretch: 22 minutes on a typical day with focus, 25 minutes at best.

recovery_cost.minimum: at least 5 disruptions after which the user got back to the app they left; a day needs 3 for its own median
recovery_cost.summary: A disruption of 36 seconds costs 1.1 minutes before the app that was left is back in front (medians over 40 disruptions). That adds up to 13 minutes a day.

repeat_offenders.minimum: an app or site that caused disruptions on at least 2 different days
repeat_offenders.summary: WhatsApp broke focus 19 times on 5 of 5 days with focus, 15 minutes in total. Next: Instagram, 13 times on 4 days.

drift.minimum: browsing data (web visits) and at least one focus stretch or planned work block
drift.summary: 2 minutes of off task browsing during focus on 5 days with focus: social 2 minutes.

late_screens.minimum: at least 3 nights inside the range on days with device data; usual bedtime needs 3 recorded sleeps of 3 hours or more; the recovery comparison needs 3 late and 3 other nights
late_screens.summary: Screens on after 23:00 on 4 of 6 nights, a median of 61 minutes. Most used then: Instagram.

context_switching.minimum: at least 60 minutes of active device time in the range; a day needs 30 active minutes for its own rate
context_switching.summary: 39 app switches per active hour. 29% of screen time is spent in stays shorter than 2 minutes (median stay 21 seconds).

time_by_app.minimum: any Mac or iPhone app usage in the range
time_by_app.summary: Screen time 8h 38 a day over 7 days (Mac 3h 21, iPhone 5h 17). Most of it: social 2h 55, other 2h 29, communication 100 minutes a day.

ai_tool_use.minimum: at least one AI session in the range; the waiting share needs sessions that report waiting time
ai_tool_use.summary: AI tools open for 2h 25 a day by the clock, 9 sessions a day (63 sessions, 20h 43 of session time in total). 36% of session time was the tool waiting for the user.
